verdict.rationale: Runpod documents Instant Clusters as fully managed multi-node compute where you can "deploy jobs" without managing infrastructure, networking, or cluster configuration. That covers the story's goal of not building your own cluster management. However, no evidence names a managed Slurm or Kubernetes scheduler, or describes any job-queueing or scheduling layer. missing for 10: explicit managed Slurm support, explicit managed Kubernetes support, documented job scheduling/queueing semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
